description: This file implements deflate/inflate streams for WebSocket message compression, including zlib and libdeflate support, with classes for managing compression and decompression streams.

classes.name: ZlibContext
classes.description: Holds buffers and optional libdeflate decompressor/compressor instances for zlib operations.

classes.name: DeflationStream
classes.description: Handles deflation (compression) of data streams with optional reset capability.

classes.name: InflationStream
classes.description: Handles inflation (decompression) of data streams with optional reset capability.

methods.name: inflate
methods.description: Decompresses a compressed data buffer, returning a string view or nullopt if failed or size exceeded.

methods.name: deflate
methods.description: Compresses a raw data buffer, returning a string view of compressed data.
